metadata.title: AI Assistants
metadata.description: Explore the future vision for AI Assistants in Orthovet: specialized agents to support reports, case organization and custom workflows.

title: AI Assistants
tagline: Assistants for the future of your workflow.

preview.title: Assistants working alongside you
preview.description: A vision of specialized agents to help organize cases and prepare reports.

facts.note: A future vision for the platform. The features presented here are still being planned.

overview.title: A team of assistants
overview.lead: The proposal is to let you have several agents inside Orthovet, each focused on a part of your workflow. They could help organize cases, prepare reports and support other tasks that currently require manual work.
overview.specialists: One assistant could help gather case information, while another could prepare a draft report. The idea is to offer specific roles with the context each task needs, rather than placing every activity in one conversation.
overview.workflows: We also envision custom workflows where different agents can work in sequence. You could define what you want to prepare and follow the steps, connecting case organization with document preparation.
overview.review: This is a vision for the platform's evolution. These features are yet to be developed, and their results should remain subject to professional review before becoming part of the case work.

availability.question: Are the agents available yet?
availability.answer: Not yet. AI Assistants is part of Orthovet's future vision. The features on this page are still being planned and illustrate what we want to develop for the platform.

tasks.question: What tasks could the agents help with?
tasks.answer: The proposal includes gathering case information, organizing notes, and preparing summaries and draft reports. We also envision custom workflows connecting these tasks inside the platform.

review.question: Will generated content need to be reviewed?
review.answer: Yes. The proposal is to help prepare content while keeping the professional responsible for reviewing it. Summaries and drafts should be checked before becoming part of the case work.

multiple.question: Will I be able to use more than one agent?
multiple.answer: That is the idea: agents specializing in different tasks, working in sequence within a workflow you define. How these workflows will be configured is still to be developed.

modules.title: Possibilities for your workflow
modules.description: Different agents for different tasks. A vision of how assistants could support work inside the platform.

reports.title: Report assistant
reports.description: Support for preparing drafts from case information, for the professional to review.

cases.title: Case assistant
cases.description: Help gathering information, organizing notes and preparing a summary of each case.

workflows.title: Custom workflows
workflows.description: Different agents combined into workflows you define, according to your routine tasks.
